```text
# #4015: Patch (part 16 of 20): no parsed input can write __proto__, constructor or prototype in the web client or the Worker (prototype pollution)
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

Item 16 of #3897: **prototype pollution**. Code writes `obj[key] = value` with a key it parsed from outside. A key of `__proto__` (or `constructor.prototype`) then changes every object in the page. First-pass verdict: 🔍 to check.

The web client merges data from the server, `localStorage` and URLs. Audit each entry point in `apps/web/src` and `apps/edge/src`:

- deck sync's `merge` (`apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.ts`);
- the loadouts' `merge` (`apps/web/src/cards/loadouts.ts`);
- settings and anything else read back from `localStorage` (`net/storage.ts` and its callers);
- deck-code import (`game/deckbuilder/deckCode.ts`);
- URL query parsing;
- any server frame or response the client folds into a plain object by its keys;
- the Worker's handling of headers and bodies.

For each one, make a key that came from outside unable to reach a prototype. Use a `Map`, an object from `Object.create(null)`, or refuse `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype`, whichever is simplest there. Add a test per entry point: feed it `{"__proto__": {"polluted": true}}` and `{"constructor": {"prototype": {"polluted": true}}}`, then check that `({}).polluted` is `undefined` and the data is otherwise read as before.

Presentation and storage only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no game rule changes.

### Acceptance

- The pull request lists each entry point checked and what it does now.
- Each entry point has its pollution test.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` green.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3897.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium: anything that is not hard

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44195159152)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Harden every outside-keyed write in the web client and the Worker so no parsed input can write `__proto__`, `constructor`, or `prototype` onto a live object. Real fixes go into the two vulnerable folds ([loadouts.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4015/apps/web/src/cards/loadouts.ts) and [store.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4015/apps/web/src/stats/store.ts)) plus a defensive guard in the deck mirror path; every other entry point is verified and pinned by a pollution test. No game rule changes (presentation and storage only).

## Files to touch

|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/wire/json.ts` | change | Add `UNSAFE_KEYS` set and `isSafeKey(key)` helper; JSDoc citing this issue |
| `apps/web/src/cards/loadouts.ts` | change | `parseCardLoadouts`: skip entries whose `cardId` fails `isSafeKey`, in both the `cards` and `stamps` loops |
| `apps/web/src/stats/store.ts` | change | `parseCounts` and `parsePlayerStats`: skip entries whose `id` fails `isSafeKey` |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.ts` | change | `parseMirror`/`entriesFrom` path: drop mirror entries whose `item.id` fails `isSafeKey` (defense in depth; `merge` already uses `Map`) |
| `apps/web/src/wire/json.test.ts` | new (or change if present; check first) | Unit tests for `isSafeKey` |
| `apps/web/src/cards/loadouts.test.ts` | change | Append pollution `it`s for `parseCardLoadouts` and the holder's `merge`/`page` |
| `apps/web/src/stats/store.test.ts` | change | Append pollution `it` for `parsePlayerStats` |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.test.ts` | change | Append pollution `it` for `parseMirror` + store merge |
| `apps/web/src/settings/store.test.ts` | change | Append pollution `it` for `parseSettings` (documents allowlist safety) |
| `apps/web/src/cards/cosmetics.test.tsx` | change | Append pollution `it` for stored card picks load (documents `Map` safety) |
| `apps/web/src/cards/settings.test.ts` | change | Append pollution `it` for card-settings parse (documents fixed-key safety) |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/deckCode.test.ts` | change | Append pollution `it` for `decodeDeckCode` (unreadable-input shape unchanged) |

| `apps/web/src/together/socialSocket.test.ts` | change if present, else new | Append pollution `it` for `parseSocialPush` |

| `apps/edge/src/alerts.test.ts` | change if present, else new | Append pollution `it` for `emailOf` with a `__proto__` field name |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; any crate under `crates/`; `spec/` notes, rulings, or pending fragments; code the task does not need. ## Steps

1. `apps/web/src/wire/json.ts`: after `isRecord`, add `export const UNSAFE_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"])` and `export function isSafeKey(key: string): boolean { return !UNSAFE_KEYS.has(key); }` with a one-line JSDoc ("issue #4015: outside keys that must never become object keys"). Copy the file's existing terse comment style.
2. `apps/web/src/cards/loadouts.ts`, `parseCardLoadouts` (~lines 99–110): in the `cards` loop, change the guard to `if (isRecord(entry) && typeof entry.cardId === "string" && isSafeKey(entry.cardId))`; same for the `stamps` loop. Import `isSafeKey` alongside `isRecord`. The holder's `merge` (~line 143) needs no edit: its inputs are now clean, and its spread targets are fixed `p1`/`p2` keys.
3. `apps/web/src/stats/store.ts`, `parseCounts` (~line 40): inside the `Object.entries` loop, add `if (!isSafeKey(id)) continue;` before the count check. In `parsePlayerStats` (~line 60), in the `value.cards` loop, add the same guard before `parseCounters`. Import `isSafeKey` from `../wire/json.ts`.
4. `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.ts`, `entriesFrom` (~line 283): after `const item = read(raw.item)`, add `if (item === null || !isSafeKey((item as { id: string }).id)) continue;`. Import `isSafeKey` alongside `isRecord`. `merge`, `deckFrom`, `trioFrom`, and `pickedDeckCosmetics` need no other edits (Map keys, destructured/fixed reads).
5. Verify-no-change entry points by reading each and confirming the stated safe shape; do not edit them: `settings/store.ts parseSettings` (loops fixed `SETTING_KEYS`), `cards/cosmetics.ts cardPicksFrom` (`Map.set`) and `normalize*` (fixed keys), `cards/settings.ts parse` (fixed `SETTING_KEYS`), `game/deckbuilder/deckCode.ts` (binary/base64 path; `catalog.cards[cardId]` keys come from the trusted catalog, `body.numbers` are numbers), `net/roomLink.ts roomLinkOf/coopLinkOf/readRoomLink` (fixed `URLSearchParams.get` names, fixed destructured fields), `net/session.ts parse` (fixed fields), `net/api.ts send` and `game/net.ts parseServerFrame`, `duos/socket.ts parseDuosFrame`, `together/socialSocket.ts parseSocialPush` (fixed `type` switch, no keyed fold), `game/deckbuilder/savedBrowse.ts parse` and `collection/newLevels.ts parseAll` (fixed-key reads / array filter), `apps/edge/src/routing.ts forServer/containerEnv` and `alerts.ts emailOf` (fixed header names / `Object.entries` read). If any of these instead does `obj[outsideKey] = …` on a plain object, apply the step-2-style `isSafeKey` guard there too and note it in the PR.
6. Add the tests listed in **Tests** below, one `it` per entry point, each feeding `{"__proto__": {"polluted": true}}` and `{"constructor": {"prototype": {"polluted": true}}}` (adapted to the input shape: raw JSON string for storage parsers, `cardId`/`id` field values for keyed folds, frame JSON text for socket parsers, query strings for URL parsers) and asserting `({}).polluted` is `undefined` (via `Object.prototype` read on a fresh object, or `( {} as Record<string, unknown>)["polluted"]`) plus unchanged normal behavior (one legitimate entry still parses).
7. Run the focused checks (exact commands in **Tests**), then `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`. Write the PR description as the entry-point list: each entry point, safe-or-fixed verdict, and what it does now.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/wire/json.test.ts`: `it("isSafeKey refuses proto keys")` — `__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype` false; `"p1"`, `"card-1"` true.
- `apps/web/src/cards/loadouts.test.ts`: `it("parseCardLoadouts drops proto cardIds")` — payload with `cards: [{cardId: "__proto__", …}, {cardId: "real", …}]` and `stamps` with `__proto__`/`constructor` entries; assert real card present, `({}).polluted` undefined. `it("holder merge keeps proto out")` — same through `createLoadoutsHolder().cards()`/`page()`.
- `apps/web/src/stats/store.test.ts`: `it("parsePlayerStats drops proto card ids")` — cards map with `__proto__` and `constructor` keys plus one real id; assert real counted, no pollution.
- `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.test.ts`: `it("mirror with proto ids restores nothing polluted")` — `parseMirror` on a mirror JSON whose deck/trio entries use `__proto__` ids plus one real dirty entry; assert real restored, no pollution.
- `apps/web/src/settings/store.test.ts`: `it("parseSettings ignores proto keys")` — JSON with `__proto__`/`constructor` plus `dragToPlay: false`; assert setting applied, no pollution.
- `apps/web/src/cards/cosmetics.test.tsx`: `it("stored card picks ignore proto ids")` — storage JSON keyed by `__proto__` plus a real card id; assert real resolved, no pollution.
- `apps/web/src/cards/settings.test.ts`: `it("card settings ignore proto keys")` — same shape as settings test.
- `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/deckCode.test.ts`: `it("decodeDeckCode refuses proto-shaped junk unchanged")` — `decodeDeckCode('{"__proto__":{"polluted":true}}', catalog, null)` returns the existing not-a-code message; no pollution.
- `apps/web/src/net/roomLink.test.ts`: `it("room/coop links ignore proto params")` — searches like `?room=…&__proto__=x`, `?coop=…&constructor[prototype]=…`; assert link parses (or null for bad code) and no pollution; `readRoomLink` with sessionStorage holding `{"__proto__":…,"code":"…","mode":null}` still reads the code.
- Frame parsers (`game/net.test.ts`, `duos/socket.test.ts`, `together/socialSocket.test.ts`): `it("…frame with proto keys does not pollute")` — text frames containing top-level `__proto__`/`constructor` keys; assert null or a well-formed frame, plus no pollution.
- `apps/edge/src/routing.test.ts`: `it("forServer ignores hostile headers")` — request carrying `X-Forwarded-For: evil` and a `__proto__` header; assert forwarded-for replaced by `CF-Connecting-IP` (or deleted) and no pollution. `apps/edge/src/alerts.test.ts`: `it("emailOf with proto field names does not pollute")` — `fields` built via `JSON.parse('{"__proto__":{"polluted":true},"cause":"start"}')`; assert body renders, no pollution.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/wire/json.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/cards/loadouts.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/stats/store.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/deckbuilder/sync.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/settings/store.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/deckbuilder/deckCode.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/roomLink.test.ts`, `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge`, then typecheck and eslint from the acceptance list. Each new test must fail without its fix (verify by temporarily reverting the guard for the two vulnerable files).

## Done when

- [ ] Each entry point named in the task is listed in the PR with its verdict and current behavior.
- [ ] Each entry point has its pollution test, asserting `({}).polluted` is `undefined` and normal reads unchanged.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` green.
- [ ] No crate, spec note, or forbidden path changed; no test weakened, no lint suppression added.

## Risks

- Spread/`Object.assign` copies of a parsed `__proto__` own-property are own data properties, not prototype sets, but later keyed reads (`catalog.cards["__proto__"]` returning `Object.prototype`) can crash or mis-resolve: the guards keep such keys out before they are stored, and frame parsers never index by outside keys.
- `Map`-keyed stores (card picks, deck merge) are already safe; the fix normalizes on skipping at parse time so serialized snapshots never carry the keys either.
- Fixed-key readers (settings, cosmetics, session, URL params) change nothing, avoiding behavior drift; their tests pin that.
- Worker scope is header/env passthrough with no body-to-object fold; tests pin passthrough rather than adding parsing.

## Open questions

None. The item stays medium: no engine rules, no AI, no cross-crate design, no migration, and well under 40 files.
```
